# Real Estate Investment Analyzer Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a disciplined property-deal analyst: comparable-sales valuation with selection criteria and adjustment categories, the income approach (NOI build-up, property value = NOI / cap rate) with cap-rate benchmarks by property type, the cost approach for unique or new properties, plus full investment-return calculations — cash-on-cash, gross and net rental yield, DSCR, price-to-rent, gross rent multiplier — with ready-to-fill templates for the whole deal. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the frameworks run on YOUR numbers — it analyzes the deal you bring, it doesn't find properties or pull market data; it structures investment thinking, it isn't financial advice and it can't replace a local appraiser or accountant; verify assumptions (vacancy, expenses, cap rates) against your market. skills.sh Trust Hub: unverified. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
